# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| list-export | Files landed under `90-Sources/sharepoint/<list>/` | `bc-portfolio` | Items, complete item version history, attachment metadata and attachment binaries are exported (never current items only); Counts verified against the list's own item count; Not hand-edited |
| export-run-log | `assets/export-run-log.md`, filled | `bc-portfolio` | Date, counts, mode (full or incremental) and the schema check result are recorded, so capture date and row counts need no re-deriving |
| schema-check-result | Line in the run log from `scripts/check_export_schema.py` | `bc-portfolio`, OD lead | Result is `OK`, or every finding is carried forward in the log |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| list-export | manual | OD lead |
| export-run-log | structure of `assets/export-run-log.md` | OD lead |
| schema-check-result | manual | OD lead |

## Handoff

- **Receives from:** `dept-context`
- **Next:** bc-portfolio reads the export plus the run log.: `bc-portfolio`
- **Stops here when:** counts do not match the list's item count, or the schema check reports a finding before an incremental run
- **Stops here when:** Carry the finding forward
- **Stops here when:** do not re-run and hope, and do not present a figure without its capture date
- **Stops here when:** If an analysis needs deleted binaries, recycle-bin contents, audit-log history, attachment versions or permissions history, this route cannot supply them
